grid_rules.description: Each occupied floor section has one backtick at the center of its inclusive 5x3 glyph footprint. Adjacent sections share their outside edge.
grid_rules.mask_semantics: Each # is one usable floor section and possible character position.

room_shell_rules.description: A rectangular room has one more repeated north-wall span than usable floor-section centers.
The east wall is a recessed three-glyph projection: inner |, alternating / or space face, and outer |.

notes: Promote only approved recurring corrections into this file.
Keep full one-off target artwork in style_samples/targets.
